title: C++ Command-line Task Tracker
summary: Grow one small task tracker from basic input and CRUD into a tested, persistent multi-file program, then handle an unfamiliar change request.

milestones.title: Basic input, output, and CRUD
milestones.outcome: Create, list, complete, and remove in-memory tasks through a command-line menu.

milestones.title: Functions, types, and modules
milestones.outcome: Separate the task model, commands, and presentation behind small testable interfaces.

milestones.title: Search, sort, and priority
milestones.outcome: Search and order tasks, including a priority queue view with deterministic ties.

milestones.title: File persistence and recovery
milestones.outcome: Save and restore tasks with explicit handling for missing or malformed data.

milestones.title: Tests, build, Git, and documentation
milestones.outcome: Provide repeatable build and test commands, boundary tests, a confirmed Git milestone, and concise usage documentation.

milestones.title: Unfamiliar change: recurring tasks
milestones.outcome: Add recurring tasks without breaking persistence compatibility, explain the design trade-off, and prove it with tests.
